waivers.reason: glib 0.18.5 (unsound VariantStrIter iterators) comes with Tauri 2's GTK 0.18 Linux stack and the fix needs glib >= 0.20; neither control-TV nor any locked crate with sources present uses VariantStrIter. Owner-approved 2026-10-15; see SECURITY.md, Dependency advisories.

crypto-bigint 0.5.5 comes only through webrtc 0.14 -> dtls -> p256/p384 0.13 -> elliptic-curve, with no compatible fix (dtls 0.17.2 still needs p256 ^0.13). The fixed constant-time paths are absent from 0.5.5 or not called by that chain; DTLS signatures use ring and p256/p384 only compute single-use ECDHE keys. Accepted for local-network trials only until the webrtc 0.21 migration. Owner-approved 2026-10-25; see SECURITY.md, Dependency advisories.
